"""Envelope/warmup brute-force check with larger P and sparse anchors (multi-cycle warmup)."""
import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, ref, para, algo

seed=int(sys.argv[1]); cnt=int(sys.argv[2]); maxP=int(sys.argv[3])
rng=random.Random(seed)
bad=0; warms=[]
for it in range(cnt):
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng)
    cal=para.build_calib(prof)
    if not cal.feasible: continue
    fb=gen.gen_fabric(rng, cal.K, maxP=maxP)
    # sparsify anchors to force multi-cycle warmup
    if rng.random()<0.6:
        P=ref.period(fb['interval_ns'],fb['slice_ns'],len(fb['slices']))
        a=rng.randrange(fb['n']); s=rng.randrange(P); e=min(P,s+1+rng.randrange(max(1,P//4)))
        fb['anchors']=[[a,s,e]]
        fb['drift_ppb']=[rng.randint(0,2) for _ in fb['drift_ppb']]
        fb['heat']=[]
    for g in fb['guards_ns']:
        fab,B,A,peak,warm = ref.envelope(fb,cal,g)
        warms.append(warm)
        ok=ref.check(fb,cal,g,extra_cycles=2)
        if not ok:
            bad+=1
            print('FAIL',json.dumps(fb),'g=',g)
            if bad>2: sys.exit(1)
print('done bad=',bad,'max warm',max(warms) if warms else None,'n',len(warms))
